content: Metronidazole can increase the plasma levels or pharmacological effects of iloperidone by inhibiting the metabolism mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Caution is advised, and monitoring is recommended during coadministration. Metronidazole can elevate the levels or effects of indinavir by interfering with CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Clinical caution and monitoring are necessary. Metronidazole increases the plasma concentration or effect of isavuconazonium sulfate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Metronidazole enhances the levels or effects of isoniazid by affecting the hepatic enzyme CYP2E1 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Metronidazole increases ivacaftor levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. If coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, reduce the ivacaftor dose. Refer to specific ivacaftor-containing product guidelines for precise dosage adjustments. Metronidazole raises the plasma concentration or effect of ivosidenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase ivosidenib plasma levels, heightening the risk of QTc prolongation. Monitor for QTc interval prolongation. Metronidazole increases the levels or effects of ixabepilone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates the plasma concentration or effect of lapatinib by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Metronidazole enhances the levels or effects of lefamulin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor for adverse effects if lefamulin is coadministered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. Metronidazole increases the plasma concentration or effect of levamlodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A inhibitors increases systemic exposure to amlodipine, potentially necessitating dose reduction. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema to determine the need for dose adjustment. Metronidazole decreases the levels or effects of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral hormonal forms and carries a low risk of contraceptive failure. Use caution and monitor, as antibiotics may reduce hormonal contraceptive efficacy. Metronidazole increases lopinavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Metronidazole elevates loratadine levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases losartan levels or effects by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism, potentially reducing the conversion of losartan to its active metabolite E-3174. The clinical significance of this interaction is not established; monitor individual therapeutic response to adjust losartan dosage as needed. Metronidazole raises lumateperone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Reduce the lumateperone dose to 21 mg/day if coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Metronidazole increases lumefantrine levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates maraviroc levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Metronidazole enhances mavacamten levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Initiation of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may necessitate a reduced mavacamten dose. Metronidazole increases mavorixafor levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are advised. Monitor for adverse effects, and reduce the mavorixafor daily dose if necessary. Metronidazole raises mefloquine levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole decreases mestranol levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral hormonal forms and carries a low risk of contraceptive failure. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases mestranol levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Metronidazole elevates methadone levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases methylprednisolone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Metronidazole raises midazolam levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases naldemedine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor for potential adverse effects if coadministered with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Metronidazole enhances nateglinide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Metronidazole raises nelfinavir levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases nicardipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates nilotinib levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Metronidazole raises nisoldipine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases norgestrel levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic norgestrel concentrations, raising the risk of adverse effects. Metronidazole elevates oliceridine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. If concomitant use is necessary, less frequent oliceridine dosing may be required. Monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation, and titrate subsequent doses accordingly. If the inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing the oliceridine dosage until stable drug effects are achieved. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal. Metronidazole and ondansetron both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor. Exercise caution if metronidazole is coadministered with intravenous ondansetron or a higher IV dose (do not exceed 16 mg IV). Metronidazole increases palbociclib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates palovarotene levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Avoid coadministration of palovarotene, a CYP3A substrate, with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. If unavoidable, reduce the palovarotene dose by 50%. Metronidazole raises parecoxib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases pazopanib levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Avoid coadministration of pazopanib with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors if possible; if coadministration is necessary, reduce the pazopanib dose to 400 mg/day. Metronidazole elevates phenytoin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases prednisone levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises quetiapine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole enhances quinidine levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases repaglinide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises rimegepant levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Avoid repeating the rimegepant dose within 48 hours if coadministered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. Metronidazole elevates ritonavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases ruxolitinib levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises ruxolitinib topical levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole enhances seladelpar levels by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Exercise caution in patients who are poor CYP2C9 metabolizers taking seladelpar and coadministered a moderate/strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Metronidazole decreases the effects of sodium picosulfate/magnesium oxide/anhydrous citric acid by altering metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Coadministration with antibiotics reduces efficacy by altering colonic bacterial flora needed to convert sodium picosulfate to its active form. Metronidazole increases solifenacin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises sonidegib levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Avoid coadministration of sonidegib with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. If a moderate CYP3A inhibitor must be used, administer it for less than 14 days and monitor closely for adverse reactions, particularly musculoskeletal adverse effects. Metronidazole elevates sparsentan levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. No dosage adjustment is needed. Regularly monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, edema, and kidney function if sparsentan is coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Metronidazole increases sufentanil SL levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Coadministration with any CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase sufentanil plasma concentrations, potentially leading to prolonged or severe adverse effects, including fatal respiratory depression. Metronidazole increases sunitinib levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises suvorexant levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Decrease the suvorexant starting dose to 5 mg at bedtime if coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Metronidazole elevates tacrolimus levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases tadalafil levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole affects tamoxifen metabolism by inhibiting CYP3A4, reducing its conversion to N-desmethyl tamoxifen, an active metabolite with similar biological activity. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises tamsulosin levels by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Dose reduction may be necessary for coadministered drugs predominantly metabolized by CYP3A. Metronidazole increases temsirolimus levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates tezacaftor levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Adjust the tezacaftor dosage regimen if coadministered with a moderate CYP3A inhibitor. Metronidazole raises theophylline levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases tinidazole levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates tipranavir levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises tofacitinib levels by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. No specific dose adjustment is recommended when tofacitinib is coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors; however, decrease the tofacitinib dose if coadministered with both moderate CYP3A4 and potent CYP2C19 inhibitors. Metronidazole increases tolterodine levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates trabectedin levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises trazodone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole increases triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates triazolam levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole raises vardenafil levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Vardenafil dosage may need to be reduced if coadministered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Metronidazole increases verapamil levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole elevates voclosporin levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Metronidazole increases warfarin levels by an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor. Metronidazole may potentiate the anticoagulant effect of warfarin and other oral coumarin anticoagulants, leading to prolonged prothrombin time. Metronidazole raises zanubrutinib levels or effects by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor.
